title: Promote Drafts
body: Using the board at {{board_url}}, review every spec in draft status and promote to ready the ones that meet the promotion gate in the nightshift skill; for the rest, leave a comment explaining what's missing.

title: Work Queue To Done
body: Using the board at {{board_url}}, work every spec in draft, ready, and blocked status to completion, following the nightshift skill and kit conventions, until nothing actionable remains.

title: Clear Blocked
body: Using the board at {{board_url}}, go through every blocked spec and either unblock it (resolve the dependency, split it, or fix the drift) or state precisely why it must stay blocked.

title: Kickoff Single Spec
body: Using the board at {{board_url}}, load spec {{spec_id}} and implement it end-to-end per the nightshift worker brief.

title: Verify In Progress Batch
body: Using the board at {{board_url}}, independently verify every spec currently in_progress and report pass/fail with evidence for each.

title: Drift Health Check
body: Using the board at {{board_url}}, run a doctor-style pass over this board: report spec/status drift, orphaned handoffs, and stale in_progress entries.
